purpose: Deterministic analytical oracle for testing axial stiffness, section geometry, force equilibrium and unit/calculation plumbing. Not a building design or proof of code compliance.

model.idealization: Prismatic rectangular bar fixed at one end and loaded by a centered axial tensile force at the other end.
assumptions: ideal fixed support and centered axial load
self-weight, stress concentrations, buckling, connections, fatigue, fire and material defects ignored
model.sign_convention: tension, displacement and support reaction magnitudes are reported as positive scalar magnitudes

interpretation.pass_means: The elementary axial-bar equations, geometry consistency and unit/calculation plumbing match this synthetic reference within the stated tolerance.
does_not_mean: A finite-element solver has been independently validated.
The bar or a real building member is adequate or code-compliant.
Buckling, local effects, connections, load combinations, fire, fatigue or material variability have been checked.
